name: mRemoteNG
description: mRemoteNG's Windows updater downloads a channel-described MSI, requires Authenticode verification against the metadata thumbprint, and compares the file's SHA-512 before accepting it. The reviewed source does not establish authentication of the channel metadata or a weekly schedule.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; metadata signing/authentication, framework/platform installer behavior, weekly scheduling, and auto-launch behavior were not independently established.
